threat_event: Attacker phishes an Integrated Payments engineer, uses the standing Cloud B administrator role to deploy a memory-scraping implant on the gateway API containers, and captures card data from card-not-present requests (P08 scenario 1)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 26 engineers with standing Cloud B administrator roles and push MFA; no PAM; Cloud B logs not monitored; open HTTPS egress
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06 Integrated Payments gateway; BP-03; about 9,000 merchants
existing_controls: Workforce MFA (push); network isolation of gateway subnets; acquired company runtime agent
treatment_plan: Move Cloud B consoles behind PAM with security keys and just-in-time elevation; remove standing roles; onboard Cloud B to the SIEM and MSSP; restrict egress to named destinations
exposure_estimate_usd: $4M-$12M (card brand assessments, PFI, notices, ISV attrition; insurance limit $20M)

threat_event: E-commerce skimming: malicious script injected into the Integrated Payments hosted payment fields captures card data in ISV checkouts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No script inventory, integrity checks, or tamper-detection on the hosted payment fields
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06 hosted payment fields; 420 ISV checkouts
existing_controls: Web application firewall; content security policy on some ISV pages (not controlled by the company)
treatment_plan: Script inventory with justification, subresource integrity, and tamper-detection on the hosted payment fields, reusing the core platform service

threat_event: Card data exfiltration from the Integrated Payments gateway goes undetected for weeks because Cloud B logs and egress are not monitored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cloud B logs kept 30 days inside Cloud B and not sent to the SIEM; no egress inspection; no covert channel detection
existing_controls: Cloud B provider threat detection enabled but not reviewed
treatment_plan: Forward Cloud B logs to the SIEM with 12-month retention; MSSP use cases for the gateway; egress allow list and DNS logging
exposure_estimate_usd: Adds $1M-$3M to R-001 for each month undetected

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over Integrated Payments partner or merchant portal accounts, issues fraudulent refunds, or changes funding accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 15,000 portal users sign in with a password only; no forced change or dynamic risk analysis; funding account changes need only the password
existing_controls: Lockout after 6 failures; refund limits per merchant
treatment_plan: Require MFA for partner administrators and users with refund or funding account rights; dynamic risk analysis for others; step-up MFA and a 3-business-day hold with call-back for funding account changes

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the settlement and funding environment in the primary colocation cage and delays clearing and funding files to both sponsor banks for more than 4 hours (P08 scenario 2)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 settlement batch servers on an unsupported operating system; colocation management network reachable after the interconnect change; default credentials on management interfaces (R-050)
regulatory_driver: C-FINANCIAL-R01 (12 CFR 53.4; 12 CFR 304.24); PCI DSS 12.10.1; 16 CFR 314.4(h)
existing_controls: EDR on settlement servers; PAM for administrators; encrypted backups at both cages; DR cage with 15-minute log shipping
treatment_plan: Replace the unsupported servers; isolate the management network; immutable offline copy of settlement backups; settlement ransomware tabletop with both sponsor banks
owner: Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations
exposure_estimate_usd: $0.5M-$3M (24-72 hours of settlement disruption, response, bank findings)

threat_event: Cloud A primary region failure stops core authorization for longer than the 2-hour MTD because failover is manual
threat_source: Cloud provider regional failure or failed deployment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Database promotion and DNS changes are manual; the 2025-11 test took 2 hours 40 minutes
existing_controls: Multi-zone deployment; warm standby in the secondary region
treatment_plan: Automate database promotion and DNS failover; semiannual failover tests

threat_event: Settlement disaster recovery takes longer than the funding cutoff, so merchant funding files to both sponsor banks are late
threat_source: Primary cage failure or destructive incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The 2026-02-21 DR test took 11 hours against an 8-hour RTO; banks not part of the test; runbook gaps
existing_controls: DR cage with 15-minute log shipping; sponsor banks can hold the ACH window for up to 3 hours
treatment_plan: Fix the DR runbook (automate database recovery and file transfer cutover); DR test with both sponsor banks; announce tests to the banks in advance (53.4(b); 304.24(b))
owner: Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations
exposure_estimate_usd: $0.5M per day plus about $104M of merchant funding delayed

threat_event: Cloud B region failure stops the Integrated Payments gateway with no standby
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single region; same-region snapshots only; no restore test
existing_controls: Multi-zone deployment in one region
treatment_plan: Cross-region snapshot copy and a restore test now; second-region standby as part of the migration to Cloud A

threat_event: Segmentation between the colocation management network and the settlement environment fails after the 2026-04-18 interconnect change, exposing the CDE
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: New routes added during the change; segmentation not retested; management network reaches the DR cage database port (P07)
existing_controls: Cage firewalls; PAM for administrators
treatment_plan: Remove the route; segmentation penetration test now and every six months; network change review requires a segmentation check

threat_event: A known vulnerability in the unsupported operating system on 4 settlement batch servers is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No vendor patches since 2025-10; compensating controls not documented
existing_controls: Network isolation inside the cage; EDR agent still supported
treatment_plan: Document compensating controls and a targeted risk analysis now; replace the servers by 2027-06-30
owner: Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations

threat_event: A departed Integrated Payments engineer or contractor uses Cloud B access keys that were not removed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cloud B IAM users outside the HR feed; 2 departed engineers had active keys in July 2026
existing_controls: Keys deactivated 2026-07-16 once found
treatment_plan: Federate Cloud B to the identity provider; remove all IAM users and long-lived keys; quarterly reconciliation to HR

threat_event: Service accounts with broad standing privileges are abused after one workload is compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 of 40 sampled service accounts hold administrator-level roles; no scheduled review
existing_controls: Vaulted secrets for Cloud A service accounts
treatment_plan: Scope each service account to its function; six-month review; vaulted and rotated secrets on all platforms

threat_event: A Cloud A or colocation administrator account is taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 110 administrators with privileged access
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant security keys; PAM with just-in-time elevation and session recording
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low; controls tested in P07 (IA-2(1) fully satisfied for the core sample)

threat_event: A service provider with CDE access or influence is compromised and exposes data or disrupts processing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7 of 34 service providers lack a current AOC or responsibility matrix
affected_asset_or_process: Service providers to SYS-01, SYS-05, SYS-06, SYS-09
existing_controls: Contracts with security terms for core vendors; annual review of Tier 1 vendors
treatment_plan: Collect AOCs or include providers in the ROC; responsibility matrices for all 34; tiered annual reviews (P09)

threat_event: Required notices are late or missed: card brands, both sponsor banks (12 CFR 53.4 and 304.24), the FTC, merchants, and states
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank B designated contacts not on file; 2025 plan does not cover Integrated Payments or crisis management
regulatory_driver: C-FINANCIAL-R01 (12 CFR 53.4; 12 CFR 304.24); 16 CFR 314.4(j); PCI DSS 12.10.1
existing_controls: Bank A contacts on file; insurer panel counsel
treatment_plan: Adopt POL-03 and both P08 runbooks with the notification matrix; record and confirm Bank B contacts quarterly; executive tabletop

threat_event: The combined 2026 ROC finds requirements not in place, producing a non-compliant AOC and sponsor bank remediation demands
threat_source: Card brands and sponsor banks (compliance program)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: First combined assessment; the gateway has several Not met requirements (P03); scope not confirmed since the acquisition
affected_asset_or_process: PCI DSS program; both sponsor relationships
regulatory_driver: PCI DSS 12.4.1; PCI DSS 12.5.2.1; PCI DSS 12.5.3
existing_controls: 2025 AOCs for both platforms; QSA relationship
treatment_plan: Close P03 High gaps or put interim measures in place before 2026-11-09; readiness review with the QSA in October

threat_event: Cryptographic keys protecting stored PAN are misused, or the DR cage cannot decrypt after a failover because key replication is stale
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DR cage HSMs last loaded 2025-08; key custodian list not reviewed since the acquisition
regulatory_driver: PCI DSS 3.6.1; PCI DSS 3.7.1; PCI DSS 3.6.1.1
existing_controls: FIPS 140-3 Level 3 HSMs; dual control and split knowledge
treatment_plan: Load current keys at the DR cage after every rotation; annual custodian review; update the cryptographic architecture description

threat_event: Card verification codes captured in contact center call recordings are exposed through a SaaS account compromise or misuse
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pause-and-resume depends on agents; 3 of 60 sampled recordings held card verification codes
existing_controls: Manual pause-and-resume; recordings encrypted by the vendor
treatment_plan: Automatic pause on payment screens; purge affected recordings; agent coaching; monthly sample check

threat_event: Full PAN kept for 7 years in the settlement archive is exposed in a breach, enlarging the number of affected cardholders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy retention setting with no documented business need
existing_controls: Archive encrypted under HSM keys
treatment_plan: Set retention to the documented business need (18 months for disputes); purge or truncate older records before ROC fieldwork; quarterly check for excess data
owner: Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations

threat_event: Fraud model drift causes a spike in false declines of legitimate transactions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drift monitoring is weekly and informal; no independent validation before releases
existing_controls: Daily decline dashboards; fallback rules
treatment_plan: Daily drift and decline alerts; independent validation before each release; rollback threshold (P10)
owner: Director of Fraud and Merchant Risk

threat_event: Fraud model declines some cardholder groups (for example prepaid card users) at unjustified higher rates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fairness testing started only in 2026-08; proxy features (card type, billing ZIP code)
existing_controls: First segment test run 2026-08-20
treatment_plan: Segment-level testing before each release and monthly (P10 bias plan)
owner: Director of Fraud and Merchant Risk

threat_event: The vendor merchant risk scoring service declines or prices sole-proprietor merchants unfairly or without an explanation they can act on
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No validation or bias testing; reason codes not shown to underwriters; vendor documentation thin
regulatory_driver: FTC Act 15 U.S.C. 45; ECOA and Regulation B applicability to be confirmed by counsel (see P10)
existing_controls: Underwriters review every decline
treatment_plan: Obtain vendor model documentation; bias test on approval rates; reason codes to underwriters; counsel opinion on ECOA and Colorado SB26-189 (P10)

threat_event: Staff paste merchant, cardholder, or security data into unapproved generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Support, disputes, and engineering adopted tools without review; no approved-tools list until 2026-09-15
existing_controls: None before 2026-09-15
treatment_plan: Approved-tools list; enterprise assistant with no-training terms; block unapproved tools; training (P10)

threat_event: AI-generated code with a vulnerability is merged into CDE software
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rule that AI-assisted changes get extra review; dependency scanning missing on Integrated Payments repositories
existing_controls: Peer review and static analysis on the core platform
treatment_plan: Label AI-assisted pull requests; mandatory security review for CDE repositories; dependency scanning on all repositories

threat_event: The merchant support chatbot gives wrong funding or fee information, or collects card numbers in chat
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No output review; chat transcripts not scanned for PAN
regulatory_driver: FTC Act 15 U.S.C. 45 (see P10); PCI DSS 3.2.1
existing_controls: Escalation to an agent on request
treatment_plan: PAN detection and masking in chat; restrict answers to approved knowledge articles; monthly quality review (P10)

threat_event: Fraudster changes a merchant funding account through social engineering of support or a compromised merchant user, diverting settlement funds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Core: call-back in place; Integrated Payments: password-only change in the portal (R-004)
existing_controls: Core portal step-up MFA and 3-business-day hold
treatment_plan: Extend step-up MFA, hold, and call-back to Integrated Payments; agent training on funding change scams
owner: Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations

threat_event: A known vulnerability in an open-source component of either platform is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dependency scanning only on core repositories; no software component inventory for the gateway
existing_controls: Monthly image rebuilds and dependency scanning on the core platform
treatment_plan: Software component inventory and dependency scanning for all repositories; 30-day window for critical findings

threat_event: Critical patches on colocation servers are applied late, leaving exploitable vulnerabilities in the settlement environment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Median 41 days to patch critical findings against a 30-day target
existing_controls: Quarterly scans; maintenance windows
treatment_plan: Monthly maintenance windows agreed with settlement operations; patch metrics to the audit committee

threat_event: Phishing captures a standard user's password and MFA approval (push fatigue)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA for standard users; 4.9% click rate in June 2026
existing_controls: Number matching; email filtering; quarterly simulations
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for all users with CDE-adjacent roles; targeted training for repeat clickers

threat_event: Contact center or support staff harvest card numbers from virtual terminal assistance or recordings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agents hear card data during assisted virtual terminal entry; recordings contain codes (R-018)
existing_controls: Background checks; clean-desk rules; portal masks PAN on display
treatment_plan: Move assisted entry to a secure payment link sent to the cardholder; monitor agent activity

threat_event: Denial-of-service attack against the API gateways degrades authorizations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing APIs on both platforms
existing_controls: Content delivery service DDoS protection for both platforms; rate limits
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low; provider protection reviewed annually

threat_event: A hurricane closes the Florida headquarters and threatens the primary colocation cage for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Headquarters and primary cage in Florida
affected_asset_or_process: Headquarters; primary cage; BP-05 to BP-07; BP-13
existing_controls: DR cage outside Florida; remote work; colocation generators
treatment_plan: Pre-storm switch of settlement to the DR cage when a hurricane warning covers the primary site; staff rosters outside the storm path
owner: Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations

threat_event: Power or cooling failure at the primary colocation facility stops settlement servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single cage per site; recovery depends on the DR cage (R-007)
existing_controls: Provider redundant power and cooling under its contract
treatment_plan: Covered by the R-007 DR improvements; annual review of the provider's availability report

threat_event: A card network link fails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Each site has its own circuits
existing_controls: Diverse circuits from both cages and Cloud A
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Director of Information Security: residual risk Low

threat_event: A stolen repository or pipeline token is used to push malicious code into the core CDE
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Personal access tokens still allowed on the core repository instance (short-lived since 2025)
existing_controls: Two approvals and signed builds for core CDE deployments; tokens expire in 30 days
treatment_plan: Replace personal tokens with workload identity; extend controls to the Integrated Payments instance

threat_event: Failure of log forwarding or another critical security control goes unnoticed, leaving blind spots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No alerts for failed EDR agents on colocation servers; Cloud B has no sources at all
existing_controls: MSSP silent-source alerts for core sources
treatment_plan: Alerts for failed agents and silent sources on all platforms; response procedure with the MSSP

threat_event: FTC enforcement after a breach because Safeguards Rule elements were missing (MFA for all users, board report coverage, encryption of all customer information)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrated Payments portal without MFA; 2025 board report did not cover the acquisition
existing_controls: Qualified Individual designated; first board report 2025-12
treatment_plan: Close the MFA gap (R-004); 2026 Qualified Individual report to the board covering the acquisition

threat_event: Integrated Payments knowledge rests with a few engineers, so outages and incidents on the gateway take longer to resolve
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gateway runbooks are thin; 5 engineers hold most production knowledge
existing_controls: Retention agreements for 5 key engineers through 2027
treatment_plan: Runbooks for the gateway; cross-train core site reliability engineers; on-call shared with the core team

threat_event: Vendors inherited from the acquisition hold company data without security terms or review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 41 acquired vendors not tiered or reviewed
existing_controls: Contracts assigned at closing
treatment_plan: Tier all 41 vendors; terminate or remediate those without security terms

threat_event: A misconfiguration in Cloud B (public storage, permissive security group) exposes gateway data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No guardrails or posture management in Cloud B
existing_controls: Manual reviews by the gateway team
treatment_plan: Apply the Cloud A guardrail set and posture management to Cloud B until migration

threat_event: Theft of a workforce laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops travel
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe; no card data on laptops
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Director of Information Security: residual risk Low

threat_event: The MSSP misses or delays escalation of a high-severity alert
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Escalation SLA monitored monthly; 1 of 40 samples late in the MSSP's SOC 2 report
existing_controls: 30-minute escalation SLA in the contract
treatment_plan: Monthly SLA review; quarterly detection test by the security team

threat_event: A sponsor bank restricts or exits the relationship after a compliance failure or incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two sponsors only; Bank A carries 78% of volume
affected_asset_or_process: Both sponsor relationships; all business units
regulatory_driver: C-FINANCIAL-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B; 12 CFR 364 App. B, through the sponsor agreements)
existing_controls: Clean AOC history; quarterly sponsor bank reviews
treatment_plan: Monthly compliance status to both banks through the 2026 ROC; SOC 2 Type 2 as requested (P09)
exposure_estimate_usd: Up to $20M+ of revenue at risk (strategic)

threat_event: The content delivery service is compromised and serves altered payment page files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The page depends on the provider for delivery
existing_controls: Subresource integrity and tamper-detection on the core page; provider AOC
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low because tamper-detection would alert within minutes

threat_event: PAN reaches the data warehouse or training environment if the automated block fails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Training extracts come from the token vault pipeline
existing_controls: Automated PAN block on load; monthly PAN discovery
treatment_plan: Keep monthly discovery; alert on any block event; annual test of the block

threat_event: Use of the merchant risk model or fraud model for consequential decisions triggers state AI or automated decision duties the company has not met
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Applicability of Colorado SB26-189 (effective 2027-01-01) and California ADMT rules not assessed
regulatory_driver: Colorado SB26-189; Cal. Code Regs. tit. 11, sec. 7200 et seq. (applicability to be assessed; see P10)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Counsel opinion on applicability by 2026-12-15; notices and human review processes ready by 2027-01-01 if needed

threat_event: The security program cannot keep up with the acquisition and migration because the team is small
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 security staff for two CDEs, two clouds, and two cages
existing_controls: vCISO; MSSP; co-sourced internal audit
treatment_plan: Hire 2 cloud security engineers (approved in the FY2027 plan); MSSP scope extended to Cloud B

threat_event: Ransomware on corporate endpoints and SaaS halts support, finance, and treasury workstations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Treasury workstations sit on the corporate network at headquarters
existing_controls: EDR with MSSP; SaaS backups
treatment_plan: Move treasury workstations to a dedicated segment reachable only through PAM; versioned SaaS backups

threat_event: Merchant owner NPI (SSNs, bank accounts) in the onboarding SaaS is exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No disposal schedule for onboarding files; broad underwriter access
existing_controls: SSO and MFA on the SaaS; vendor SOC 2
treatment_plan: Disposal two years after last use unless needed; role-based access for underwriters

threat_event: Baseboard management interfaces of settlement servers with vendor default credentials are used to take over the servers (found in P07)
threat_source: Cybercriminal or insider on the colocation management network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 of 12 settlement servers had vendor default credentials on their management interfaces, reachable from the colocation management network (P07, 2026-08-12)
existing_controls: Credentials changed 2026-08-14 after the stop-and-notify
treatment_plan: Dedicated management network reachable only through PAM; credential checks added to the configuration standard; quarterly scan for default credentials

threat_event: Gateway token vault keys in the Cloud B general key service are misused because no dual control or split knowledge applies
threat_source: Privileged insider or attacker with Cloud B administrator access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Any Cloud B administrator can use or change key policies (R-001)
existing_controls: Provider key service with logging
treatment_plan: Separate key administrator role behind PAM with two-person approval; move to the payment HSM service at migration

threat_event: A merchant funding file is altered on the file transfer server before transmission, diverting funds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Files encrypted in transit but not digitally signed; banks validate totals only
existing_controls: Dual control on file release; control totals agreed with the banks
treatment_plan: Sign funding files with an HSM-held key; both banks verify signatures
owner: Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations
